selection.distance_model: Parallax when available; redshift cosmology when available; otherwise display shell for sky placement.
selection.ordering: black holes first, then SIMBAD reference count descending

source.name: SIMBAD TAP basic table
source.query:
SELECT TOP 5000
  oid,
  main_id,
  otype,
  otype_txt,
  ra,
  dec,
  plx_value,
  rvz_redshift,
  nbref
FROM basic
WHERE ra IS NOT NULL
  AND dec IS NOT NULL
  AND otype IN ('BH', 'BH?', 'Psr')
ORDER BY nbref DESC
